description: waitpid reap-order correctness (M6-D). userspace/ctests/musl_reap.c spawns a slow child (exits 3) first, then a fast child (exits 7); wait(-1) must return the finished fast child rather than EAGAIN-blocking on the earlier-listed slow one. Then the slow child reaps with code 3, and a final wait with no children returns ECHILD. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_reap_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: wait(-1) reaped the terminated child even though an earlier-listed sibling was still running
the slow child was then reaped with its own exit code
waiting with no remaining children returns ECHILD (not ENOENT)
the reap driver ran to completion with the kernel alive

forbidden.why: wait(-1) could not reap the finished child while an earlier sibling ran
the slow child was not reaped correctly
wait with no children returned the wrong errno
